remarks: Fantastic South Norwalk location within walking distance to SoNo! This income-restricted complex presents a rare opportunity for first-time buyers to own a generous two-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bath townhouse that just needs some updates to restore its charm. Nestled in a small, quiet community, this home boasts a lovely, light-filled open floor plan. The first floor features a spacious kitchen, a half bath, and a dining room that flows into the living room and hardwood floors. Upstairs, you'll find two roomy bedrooms. Take advantage of the nearby recreational park with outdoor grilling facilities, as well as easy access to the train station, the historic SoNo area brimming with fantastic restaurants and shops, and much more! Please note that income restrictions apply, and no investors are permitted. The property is being sold as-is.
